insurer_error.description: Professional hazardous or adventure sports exclusion

letter_deductions.deduction: Professional hazardous or adventure sports exclusion
letter_deductions.why: A venue incident note records an awkward landing at an ordinary paid stage dance rehearsal. There was no stunt, acrobatic apparatus, competition, hazardous sport or adventure activity in the exercise. MRI and the operative note confirm ACL rupture and reconstruction.
